ECONOMY FOUNDATION MODULE – LECTURE 5 | NATIONAL INCOME ACCOUNTING

Are you preparing for UPSC CSE 2027, State PCS or other competitive examinations? In this class, we will understand one of the most important topics of Indian Economy – **National Income Accounting** from basic to advanced level.
National Income is a fundamental concept of Economics and plays an important role in understanding India's economic growth, development and overall performance. This lecture is specially designed to build strong conceptual clarity for beginners as well as serious aspirants.

TOPICS COVERED IN THIS CLASS:
- Introduction to National Income Accounting
- Meaning and Concepts of National Income
- Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
- Gross National Product (GNP)
- Net Domestic Product (NDP)
- Net National Product (NNP)
- GDP at Market Price and Factor Cost
- National Income Calculation Methods
- Important Economic Terms and Concepts
- Exam-Oriented Concepts and Important Facts

WHY JOIN THIS ECONOMY FOUNDATION MODULE?
This FREE Economy Foundation Module will help you understand complex economic concepts through simple explanations, structured learning and exam-oriented preparation. Build your fundamentals before moving towards advanced topics of Indian Economy.

UPSC CSE 2027, UPSC Prelims, UPSC Mains, State PCS examinations.

If you want to strengthen your Economics preparation, make sure you watch the complete lecture and revise all the important concepts.

Like the video, Share it with fellow aspirants and Subscribe to the channel for more FREE educational classes.
